trap.label: say ≠ tell
trap.wrong: She told that she was tired.
trap.right: She said that she was tired.
trap.why: Em português "disse (a mim)" não exige objeto. Em inglês tell pede pessoa (told me); sem pessoa use said.

opts: He admitted that he was late.
He admitted to that he was late.
He admitted me he was late.

mcq.q: Qual verbo usa objeto direto de pessoa?

fix.wrong: He told that the shop was closed.
fix.right: He said that the shop was closed.

fix.wrong: She suggested me to go home.
fix.right: She suggested that I go home.
They explained the problem to me.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com said: “‘I am tired,’ Ana said.”
rewrite.answer: Ana said that she was tired.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com told: “‘Wait here,’ he said to me.”
rewrite.answer: He told me to wait there.
